critical_observations: Independently solved all twelve complete complex solution sets, including the quartic substitutions and multiplicity in the synthesis item.
Verified x⁴−2x³+10x²−18x+9 = (x²+9)(x−1)², so the complete zeros are ±3i and 1 with multiplicity two.
artifact_findings: Exactly twelve interleaved problems are present after a short warm-up and culminate in an appropriate synthesis challenge.
The key reports complete real and non-real solution sets and explains conjugate pairs and multiplicity.
The study guide covers arithmetic, quadratics, checking roots, and completeness of solution sets.
rationale: Rigorous, accurate complex-number synthesis review with strong method variation and a complete, explanatory answer key.
